title: Sam Altman just revealed AGI is 2 years away — here is what that means

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Sam Altman just said AGI is coming in 2 years — and it's changing everything.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This isn’t just hype — major tech companies are already racing to get there.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: AGI is artificial general intelligence — a machine that can think and learn like a human.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key breakthrough is using massive language models that can adapt to any task.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This will transform jobs, healthcare, and even how we interact with technology.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The biggest takeaway? We’re entering a future where AI isn’t just smart — it’s everywhere.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: What do you think we’ll be able to do in just 2 years?
